agenda_items.summary: Introduces and enacts Ordinance No. 1750-NS, creating Section 8-2.06 and Title 9, Chapter 10, Article 9 of the Thousand Oaks Municipal Code to exempt qualifying deed-restricted affordable housing projects from specified municipal development impact fees. Presented by Cultural & Community Services Director Jonathan Syrett, TO Arts Executive Director Nikki Richardson, and Board Chair Al Lowe, the policy reform eliminates major upfront development cost hurdles, accelerating non-profit and workforce housing construction in Thousand Oaks.
agenda_items.outcome: Passed Unanimously (5-0 Vote: Taylor, Adam, Newman, Gutierrez, Noonan)

executive_summary: The Thousand Oaks City Council convened on September 30, 2026 to address municipal governance items. Key actions centered on **Ordinance Number 1750-Ns: Municipal Code Amendment** (introduced at 01:59:42), **Amgen Life Science Campus & Specific Plan Amendment** (introduced at 02:25:07), **Hillcrest Homes Housing Development Agreement** (introduced at 02:25:14). Council recorded 2 formal vote actions, including a unanimous 5-0 vote. The full recording spans 02:28:00 with complete timestamped remarks accessible via CTO Meetings.
